factCheck.title: Vaswani & Shazeer Breakthrough & ArXiv Citation
factCheck.footerStatus: Verified across 4 academic citations • Zero hallucination detected
factCheck.paperAuthors: Ashish Vaswani*, Noam Shazeer*, Niki Parmar*, Jakob Uszkoreit*, Llion Jones*, Aidan N. Gomez*†, Łukasz Kaiser*, Illia Polosukhin*‡
factCheck.paperAffiliations: Google Brain • Google Research • Univ. of Toronto
factCheck.attentionEquation: Attention(Q, K, V) = softmax( (Q Kᵀ) / √d_k ) V
factCheck.whyScaleDesc: For large values of d_k, the dot products grow large in magnitude, pushing the softmax function into regions where it has extremely small gradients. Dividing by √d_k counters this effect.
factCheck.diagramFig: Fig. 2: Scaled Dot-Product Attention & Multi-Head Attention
factCheck.shazeerRole: Proposed multi-head attention, dividing projection spaces so the model can simultaneously attend to information from different representation subspaces at different positions.
factCheck.parmarVaswaniRole: Authored the end-to-end WMT 2014 translation pipeline and demonstrated that self-attention alone outperformed recurrent and convolutional models without recurrence.
factCheck.computeHardware: Model training utilized 8 NVIDIA P100 GPUs for 12 hours for the base model, avoiding the catastrophic multi-day synchronization bottleneck of RNNs.

help.title: About Co-Watcher
help.subtitle: Autonomous AI Co-Viewer & Fact Synthesis
help.heading: How Co-Watcher Works
help.intro: Co-Watcher is an intelligent companion that watches long-form academic lectures, technical demos, and interviews with you in real time.
help.step1Desc: As the video plays, gem-colored markers populate the timeline. Each anchor categorizes background facts, architecture insights, and mathematical details.
help.step2Desc: Click “Verify” on any fact-check card to inspect the exact ArXiv paper snippets, author contributions, and equations.
help.step3Desc: Hit “Record Reaction” at any moment. Co-Watcher pauses the lecture, opens your camera and mic with an active decibel meter, and anchors your commentary directly to the timestamp.
help.step4Desc: Co-Watcher stitches the source clip, your reaction, and technical diagrams with automated audio ducking into a shareable landscape video or vertical short!
